== PC Discord and Retro Club facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added the streaming of the first Top 8 game and of the final (TacoBill in #podcasts-streams, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (17 March 2026), [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/749414352175759451/1483268214271250516 Discord message]; krazykarlosu in #general, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (2 April 2026), [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469473628094465/1489291566492287222 Discord message]). In the Discord posts, Hazardville/jagteq is [[Justin Miyashiro]], Wend is [[Andrew Moss]], Apollyon is [[Jason Riendeau]] and deadbody is [[Garrett Larson]], as their pages establish.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The page and the [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] row give the dates as December 2025 – March 2026. The Discord post announcing the final was posted on 2 April 2026 and says "Tonight we have the Jawa Cup Finals", so the final was played on 2 April 2026 (US time). The Players Committee's YouTube uploads of the two final games are dated 7 April 2026. The existing date range was left in place; it should end in April 2026 if a public source confirms the date of the final.
